summary: Patriot Acquisition Corp. (a blank-check company) filed an 8-K reporting the closing of its IPO on May 18, 2026, of 16,000,000 units at $10.00/unit for $160M gross proceeds, plus the partial exercise of the underwriter's over-allotment option for an additional 1,500,000 units on May 21, 2026, generating $15M. Simultaneously, it completed a private placement of 5,200,000 private placement warrants at $1.00 each to the sponsor and KBW. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing details the capital structure (units, ordinary shares, warrants) and regulatory disclosures. Watch for the de-SPAC timeline and potential target announcement, with risk-arb focus on redemption levels and shareholder approval.
